scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia! Do you know Moscovia?
the paradise spreading on the endless seas...
Welcome to Moscovia
It's adventurous and mystic.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
莫斯科比亞！您聽說過莫斯科比亞嗎？
那是無盡海洋上的樂園...
歡迎來到莫斯科比亞，這裡充滿冒險與神秘。

scripts.text: About Moscovia...
scripts.translation: 關於莫斯科比亞...

scripts.text: Go to Moscovia.
scripts.translation: 前往莫斯科比亞

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Moscovia is a beautiful kingdom
on an island located north of Rune-
Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
莫斯科比亞是個美麗的王國，坐落在盧恩·米德加茲北方的島嶼上。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sure that you will be
absolutely fascinated
by Moscovia's beautiful scenery
and gorgeous palace.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
相信莫斯科比亞的美景和壯麗的宮殿，一定會讓您著迷。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Now that our long winter has
passed,
I'm happy that I can now show you
our gorgeous hometown.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
漫長的冬天終於過去了，很高興能帶您領略我們美麗的家鄉。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you feel like visiting Moscovia
take the chance now!
I'll help you to have a nice trip
to Moscovia!
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
想去莫斯科比亞的話，現在正是好時候！
我會幫您安排一趟愉快的旅程！

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, let us start now.
You should pay me 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia.
But when you come back,
you don't have to pay.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
好，那就準備出發吧。
前往莫斯科比亞需要支付10,000 Zeny，返程免費。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Can we leave now?
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
我們現在可以出發了嗎？

scripts.text: Let's go!
scripts.translation: 出發吧！

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
如果現在沒空，想出發時再來找我就好。
我隨時可以帶您前往莫斯科比亞。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
I'm sorry but you don't have
enough zeny now
You need 10,000 zeny
to go to Moscovia
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
很抱歉，您現在的Zeny不足。
前往莫斯科比亞需要10,000 Zeny。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Ok then, we're leaving now.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
好的，我們現在出發了。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you're too busy now,
please tell me again whenever you want.
I'm always ready to guide anyone to Moscovia.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
如果現在沒空，想出發時再來找我就好。
我隨時可以帶您前往莫斯科比亞。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
How was your trip?
Do you have good memories from Moscovia?
A ship is now leaving
for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
旅途怎麼樣？
在莫斯科比亞留下美好的回憶了嗎？
現在有一艘船即將返回盧恩·米德加茲。

scripts.text: Return to Alberta
scripts.translation: 返回艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
If you want to see more
please take your time.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
還想再逛逛的話，就慢慢欣賞吧。

scripts.text:
[Moscovia P.R. Officer]
Please come and visit soon.
Ok then, Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[莫斯科比亞公關官員]
歡迎您不久後再來。
好，出發吧。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Our dear Csar Alexsay III is in the palace.
He rules over Moscovia.
Please be careful not to cause him any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
統治莫斯科比亞的沙皇亞歷克賽三世，就在宮殿裡。
請注意，別給陛下添麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Soldier]
Please be silent or the Csar will be angry.
scripts.translation:
[士兵]
請保持安靜，否則沙皇會生氣的。
